description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' implementing a menu configuration for the 'Attendance' module in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides module and screen identifiers to customize menu behavior for viewing one's own attendance record.

classes.name: EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for editing or viewing user's own attendance record by overriding module and screen parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module and screen to 'time' and 'viewMyAttendanceRecord' respectively for the given Screen object.
